footprint.basis: Native selection-box envelope in Factorio 2.1.24 including display panels.

protocol.collection: Drain only the saved passive-provider boiler chest each tick interval; output measured after warmup.
protocol.supply: Dedicated external eastbound belt placed at each west clear-approach tile; normal pipe and stone-furnace items inserted onto both feeder lanes, then must pass through each saved west belt and matching inserter into the recipe machine. No machine/chest inventory injection.
protocol.power: External electric-energy-interface attached to the included medium-electric-pole network; no power fixture included in measured blueprint area.
protocol.research: All official 2.1.24 technologies and recipes enabled identically for both separate forces; normal quality.
protocol.comparison: AM3 candidate versus same-geometry AM2 baseline. Zero modules/beacons on both; all flow, power, collection and research conditions identical.

validation.sourceRateReason: Requester chest, 12 speed-module-2 items, and four beacons in source; no matched native source run claimed.
